skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand and apply knowledge about e-commerce transactions such as B2C, B2B2C, C2C, B2B and applications of technology in management and society.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying technology and data in managing e-commerce transactions
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will apply technology and data in managing various types of e-commerce transactions and specific applications in different economic sectors.
Students will be able to find and synthesize information related to the e-commerce business environment, government, social, and digital economy.
Students will practice teamwork and present research results on e-commerce transactions.
Students will enhance their ability to study independently and apply e-commerce transactions in various platforms.
Students will develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills in the context of e-commerce transactions.
